plugins.name: vibeforge-gate
plugins.description: Repository-owned merge bar: a local pre-commit/pre-push gate that runs the checks a hosted CI service would have, without needing one.

plugins.name: coroner
plugins.description: The VibeForge Systems AI Code Coroner: adversarial architecture review as a read-only subagent — severity-ranked, file-cited findings, pre-mortem exhibits, and a strangler refactor plan. It cannot edit — diagnosis is the deliverable.

plugins.name: repo-publication-readiness
plugins.description: Take a private GitHub repo public without leaking: two secret scanners plus the merge, message and binary passes both miss; identities, internal hosts and a private employer/client deny list; rotate, rewrite and prove it; publish to a fresh, pre-protected repo and verify.
